targetAudience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on
topic: When life feels uncertain: trust in Allah
coreInsight: Qur'an 65:3 says whoever relies on Allah, He is sufficient for him, so we can keep moving without seeing every step.
selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

script.onScreen: When life feels uncertain… / You don't need to see every step.

REFLECTION / Trust, then take the next step. / Tawakkul isn't waiting with folded hands. It is doing what you can today and leaving what you can't see to Allah. You don't have to know every step ahead to keep moving forward.
He is enough. Take the next small step. / Share it with someone who needs it

caption:
You don't have to know every step ahead to keep moving forward.

Qur'an 65:3 is a reminder that whoever relies on Allah, He is sufficient for him.

Tawakkul isn't waiting with folded hands: do what you can today, and leave what you can't see to Allah.

Share it with someone who may find it helpful.

📖 Sources
• Qur'an 65:3 (tr. Saheeh International) — quran.com/65/3
Full text: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon Allah - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, Allah will accomplish His purpose. Allah has already set for everything a [decreed] extent
